description:
[Start here] Concept guide: how a part of Rust works. A short guide to one part of the game (core loop and progression, building and upkeep, raiding, electricity,
farming and genetics, fishing, monuments and puzzles, events, vehicles, NPCs, the economy, wipes, game modes and
eras, server settings, skins and the item store): `sections` of `{heading, text, fact, tools}` - `fact` is a
number-bearing statement read from the current game files or server ConVars (`game_build` cites the build),
`tools` the MCP tools/endpoints that give exact values - plus `related_topics`. Fixed text, live numbers. How a part of Rust works, in plain words, with the tools that give exact numbers. Use before answering how/why questions ('how does upkeep work', 'what is a soft side', 'how do keycards work').
